status_detail: No new SHA-256 hashes met the evidence standard for this review date. The current Daily-Threat-Intel archive contained one malicious C2 IP, which was excluded because this repository publishes SHA-256 file hashes only.
blocker: The public MalwareBazaar recent-hash export provides volume but not the per-hash family and confirmation metadata required by this repository. The metadata-rich API/export requires an authenticated source access path.
